Definition: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of G188; the extremity:--one end… other, tip, top, uttermost part.
BiblicalUsage: The extremity — the tip, the top, the uttermost part. The angels gather the elect from the uttermost part of heaven; the rich man begs for Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water; and Jacob, dying, worships leaning upon the top of his staff.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for the tip or the uttermost part carries little weight on its own; its weight is Jacob's use, a dying man worshipping on the top of his staff.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
